🏛️ Building-Integrated Photovoltaics (BIPV) Engineering Guide

Complete BIPV Solar Systems & Key Difference: BIPV vs. BAPV

Modern solar architecture goes far beyond conventional rooftop racks. Solviro Energy designs and installs complete Building-Integrated Photovoltaics (BIPV)—turning your building's roof tiles, facades, windows, skylights, doors, balconies, and carports into active clean power generators.

BIPV • Architectural Integration Replaces Building Material

BIPV (Building-Integrated Photovoltaics)

The solar element IS the building material itself—directly replacing conventional clay/slate roof tiles, exterior curtain walls, rainscreen cladding, window glass, skylights, doors, or balcony railings.

  • ✔ Dual Function & Cost Offset: Saves the cost of traditional construction materials (roofing tiles, facade stone, toughened railing glass) while generating clean solar power.
  • ✔ Weatherproofing & Thermal Insulation: Acts as a weather-tight, acoustic-insulated structural envelope that blocks up to 85% UV and infrared solar heat gain.
  • ✔ Seamless Luxury Aesthetics: Zero visible aluminum clamping rails or protruding brackets—ideal for modern villas, hotels, commercial towers, and apartments.
BAPV • Retrofit Mounting Mounted on Existing Roof

BAPV (Building-Applied Photovoltaics)

Traditional solar panels mounted on top of an already finished roof or structure using hot-dip galvanized steel or anodized aluminum mounting structures and clamps.

  • ✔ Fast Retrofit on Existing Buildings: Easily installed on existing RCC flat roofs, tin sheds, or sloped roofs without altering the underlying building structure.
  • ✔ Optimal South Tilt Angle: Racking structures can be tilted at an exact 22°–24° South angle in Madhya Pradesh to maximize peak kWh generation per kWp.
  • ✔ Elevated Usable Roof Space: High-rise elevated GI structures allow full walking space and terrace usage underneath the solar array.

Broad-Spectrum Solar Maintenance, Cleaning & Engineering Services

In Madhya Pradesh's high-dust environment, uncleaned solar panels, bird droppings, hard-water scaling, and loose DC connectors silently steal 18% to 32% of your daily electricity generation. Whether your solar system was installed by Solviro Energy or any third-party vendor, our dedicated CleanPro™ O&M Engineering Fleet in Rewa, Satna, Sidhi, Singrauli, Katni, Jabalpur, and Mauganj restores your plant to 100% peak output.

+25% Yield Recovery Immediate power boost
30 Ft Rotary Nylon Brush Scratch-free DM wash
IR Drone Thermal Hotspot Audit Cell & diode diagnostics
24–48 Hr Emergency Breakdown On-site engineer visit
Open to All Solar Owners in MP

Book a one-time Deep Mechanized Wash & Electrical Health Check or subscribe to an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC).

🚿 Zero Micro-Scratch

1. Mechanized Rotary Brush & Robotic Panel Cleaning

Water-fed 30-ft telescopic carbon-fiber poles with soft rotating nylon bristles and de-mineralized (low-TDS) water jets. Removes stubborn cement dust, bird droppings, pollen, and hard-water limescale deposits without scratching anti-reflective (AR) glass coatings. Automatic dry/wet robotic cleaners available for large industrial sheds.

🚁 Infrared Thermography

2. Aerial Drone Thermal Imaging & Hotspot Audits

High-resolution infrared thermal camera inspections to detect invisible cell-level hotspots, micro-cracks, snail trails, Potential-Induced Degradation (PID), and shorted bypass diodes before they overheat or trigger warranty loss. Includes a complete annotated thermal health report.

⚡ Electrical Safety

3. IV-Curve Tracing, Earthing Pit & SPD Diagnostics

Digital string-level VOC, ISC, and insulation resistance testing; MC4 connector thermal check to prevent DC arcing; chemical earthing pit ohmic testing (<2 Ohms verification) and recharging; ACDB/DCDB Surge Protection Device (SPD) and Lightning Arrestor (LA) continuity audits.

📟 Inverter & Battery Care

4. Inverter Servicing, Firmware & Battery Balancing

Internal dust blowing and heat-sink fan cleaning for string/hybrid inverters, MPPT firmware updates, Wi-Fi/4G monitoring dongle reconnection, LiFePO4 BMS cell-voltage balancing, and specific gravity/distilled water topping for tubular lead-acid battery banks.

🔩 170 km/h Wind Safety

5. Structure Torque Tightening & Anti-Rust Treatment

Pre-monsoon structural audit checking torque on all mid-clamps, end-clamps, and foundation anchor bolts; cold-galvanizing zinc spray touch-ups on weld joints; and roof anchor waterproofing sealant inspection to guarantee zero roof leakage.

🕊️ Pigeon & Shade Guard

6. Bird-Proofing Mesh, Retrofits & System Upgrades

Installation of non-invasive UV-stabilized PVC-coated wire mesh around panel skirts to prevent pigeons and squirrels from nesting and chewing DC cables beneath panels. We also upgrade older off-grid/on-grid plants with new LiFePO4 batteries or hybrid inverters!
